influences.name: friend in Brazil
influences.context: I received this immersive audio from a friend of mine in Brazil and he said 'you should do music like this' and I really enjoyed what I was listening

influences.name: Carla Morrison
influences.context: She is very beautiful and an amazing storyteller... She is very cool, bohemian, chic, and she is just real, and I'm just obsessed with her.

influences.name: Bad Bunny
influences.context: I just work with people that I respect. I think that Bad Bunny, even though he's young, he's making the right decisions and everything he's presenting to the audience, he's always pushing the envelope. I like that from young artists.
